title: Fermionic Love number of higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordström black holes
summary: In this paper, we generalize our previous work on the fermionic tidal Love numbers (TLNs) to higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordström black holes. The massless Dirac equation is solved in $D$-dimensional spacetime using ingoing Eddington coordinates and regular tetrads. After identifying the regular solution branch, we extract the fermionic TLNs from its asymptotic behavior at infinity. The resulting TLNs exhibit a rich dimension-dependent structure that generalizes the four-dimensional case.
